description: P43-REPAIR-01: retained P43-PRODUCT-12 Dotconf Debug Repair inputs (TE 408). Pre-repair dotconf/parser.py (reconstruction), the Change Set generated regression test, the frozen Task text, and the debug_feedback_captured envelope. Vendored so CI never reads gitignored docs/ evidence.
task_text:
Fix a parsing defect in the dotconf configuration library. A quoted value that contains a `#` preceded by whitespace is cut off at that point instead of being kept as part of the value. For example, `loads('PASSWORD="abc # def"')` raises `ParseError` ("unterminated double-quoted value") instead of returning `{"PASSWORD": "abc # def"}`, and `loads(dumps({"NOTE": "a #b"}))` does not round-trip. Single-quoted values are affected in the same way.

Requirements:
- Inside single-quoted and double-quoted values, `#` is ordinary text.
- A quoted value may still be followed by whitespace and an inline `# comment`.
- Preserve all other existing behavior, including inline comments on unquoted values and the existing `ParseError` messages.
- Create a new regression test file `tests/test_quoted_hash_regression.py` containing at least one pytest test that fails on the current code and passes after the fix.
- Do not modify `tests/test_dotconf_acceptance.py`.

Independent acceptance contract (required):
- `python -m pytest tests/test_dotconf_acceptance.py -q`
